facts.sub: Quase toda cidade turística americana tem um visitor center com mapas e folhetos. A equipe sugere passeios, horários e restaurantes, e geralmente não cobra nada pela informação.

pages.title: Plans for the weekend · 1/3
paragraphs: Paul arrives in New Orleans on Friday morning. He has only two days and many ideas. The city is warm and full of music. He finds a tourist center near the river. A guide named Tina sits at a wooden desk. She has a warm smile and a pile of maps.
“Welcome to New Orleans! Can I help you?” says Tina. “Yes. What can I do in two days?” says Paul. “You can ride the streetcar and walk around the French Quarter.” says Tina.
